gloss: to replace, to exchange, to swap

definitions.gloss: to replace, to exchange, to swap
definitions.explanation: To remove one thing and put another in its place, or to exchange two things with each other. Used for replacing worn-out items, swapping objects, and exchanging goods.

examples.japanese: {電池|でんち}を{取|と}り{換|か}える。
{古|ふる}くなったタイヤを{新|あたら}しいのに{取|と}り{換|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced the worn-out tires with new ones.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}のカーテンを{季節|きせつ}ごとに{取|と}り{換|か}えるようにしている。
examples.english: I make it a point to swap out the curtains in my room each season.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as {取|と}り{替|か}える. Both kanji spellings ({換|か}える and {替|か}える) are used, with {換|か} emphasizing technical replacement and {替|か} emphasizing general swapping. In practice they are often interchangeable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電球|でんきゅう}を{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a light bulb
- フィルターを{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a filter
- {部品|ぶひん}を{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace a part
- {新品|しんぴん}に{取|と}り{換|か}える: replace with a new one

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}り{換|か}える focuses on removing one item and inserting another. {交換|こうかん}する is more formal and often implies a mutual exchange. {入|い}れ{替|か}える emphasizes putting something new in place of the old.
